programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = []\n    for tile_r in range(3):\n        for r in range(h):\n            src_r = h - 1 - r if tile_r % 2 == 0 else r\n            row = []\n            for tile_c in range(2):\n                if tile_c == 0:\n                    row.extend(reversed(grid[src_r]))\n                else:\n                    row.extend(grid[src_r])\n            out.append(row)\n    return out\n'''
